defects.description: Description: "Bring ONE arm across the chest, resting the hand near the opposite shoulder". Currently L arm reaches back-out (shoulderFwdL=+30 BEHIND, leftShoulder=60). Other arm (R) is the crosser candidate but currently also swings back. Neither arm crosses chest.
shoulderFwdL/R both positive (BEHIND per corrected convention). For cross-chest, arm should swing FORWARD (negative shoulderFwd) so forearm reaches across body.
leftShoulder=60 vs rightShoulder=-10 (70° asymmetry). Description implies ONE arm crosses, OTHER relaxed at side.

failing_tests.expected: wrist crosses body midline (x sign change) at chest level
failing_tests.actual: wristR at (0.582, 0.104, 0.091) — far RIGHT, no cross; wristL at (0.118, -0.010, -0.100) — at center, hip level

regression_risk: medium — significant arm reorientation. Re-render verify required.
rationale: L arm = relax at side: leftShoulder 60 → 0 (arm down at side), shoulderFwdL 30 → 0 (no swing), leftElbow 95 → 30 (slight bend, relaxed). Result: wristL=(-0.467, 0.009, -0.024) — at hip level on LEFT side, relaxed. R arm = cross chest to opposite shoulder: rightShoulder -10 → -30 (R arm raised 30° up), shoulderFwdR 10 → -90 (strong FORWARD swing per - = forward; brings forearm forward across body), rightElbow 30 → 100 (deep bend, forearm crosses chest). Result: wristR=(-0.089, 0.247, -0.097) — at chest level on LEFT side (crossed midline from R to L), approximation of "hand near opposite shoulder". Rig-limited: cannot truly cross horizontally (renderer elbow only rotY); forearm reaches forward and bends, ending on opposite-side chest. Legs PRESERVED: hipAbductL=+12 + hipAbductR=-15 (both legs cross to RIGHT side per description "legs bent and folded to one side"). globalTwist=-10 preserved (slight body angle toward plant).
